Scroll-reveal scan order

Everything below this hero sits in a reveal wrapper that is at opacity 0 until the page is scrolled to it. A rule pass that reads the page before the reveal sweep runs measures none of the left column and flags the fade-in raster in the right one.

Revealed column that must flag

Body copy at 1.6:1 against the page background. It is legible to the element pass only once the reveal wrapper has transitioned to full opacity, which is what a visitor scrolling the page actually sees.

A second paragraph set at 1.1 line-height, tight enough that the descenders of one line touch the ascenders of the next when the text wraps across the measure of this column.

Revealed column that must stay clean

The same amount of body copy at full contrast against the page background. It reveals on the same wrapper as the left column, so a pass that reads the post-reveal page sees it and finds nothing wrong with it.

A second paragraph at 1.6 line-height, the leading this size of text wants, wrapping across the same measure as the paragraph it is paired with on the other side of this fixture.
